title: Run pre bag out to exchange the lowest 25% of destinations per sorter leg
summary: Use the bag out control system to run “pre bag out,” which exchanges the lowest 25% of destinations per sorter leg.
when_to_use: When you need to perform the pre bag out behavior that exchanges the lowest 25% of destinations per sorter leg.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Run the pre bag out option in the bag out control system and ensure the behavior applies per sorter leg as intended.
